name: Miyu Himura
source:
Miyu has an air of authority and dignity. She's a little hard to talk to, but it should get easier as you earn her respect.

Miyu is your senior, ans she seems to be an over-achiever. You'll have to work hard if you want to live up to her high standards if you want to date her.
translation:
Miyu has an air of authority and dignity. She's a little hard to talk to, but it should get easier as you earn her respect.

Miyu is your senior, ans she seems to be an over-achiever. You'll have to work hard if you want to live up to her high standards if you want to date her.
